title: Logarithmic intermittency of the critical 2D SHF
summary: While the solution to the $1+1$ dimensional stochastic heat equation with multiplicative noise is closely related to the exponential of a Brownian motion, the two-dimensional picture exhibits an additional weak-to-strong disorder transition. In [CSZ '23], the critical two-dimensional stochastic heat flow (SHF) was constructed as the scaling limit of the partition function of $2+1$ dimensional directed polymers under the logarithmic intermediate-disorder scaling at criticality.
